sloka: तं ब्रुवाणं तु तद्वाक्यं राजर्षिं धार्मिकं तदा ।जिघृक्षुरब्रवीत्कन्यां बाढमित्येव स द्विजः ।। ७.२.२७ ॥
transliteration: taṁ bruvāṇaṁ tu tadvākyaṁ rājarṣiṁ dhārmikaṁ tadā ।jighṛkṣurabravītkanyāṁ bāḍhamityeva sa dvijaḥ ।। 7.2.27 ॥

translations.english: Then, that brahmin (Pulastya), wishing to accept the daughter, said "Certainly, yes" to the righteous royal sage who was speaking those words.
